task_instance: Invoke the confide:vault skill's core deliverable: run its bundled checker (skills/vault/scripts/vault.py --check / --json) to produce the read-only THREE-LOCKS status report for storing RED session data, reporting each lock (device FileVault, dedicated encrypted store, per-file sops/age) as pass/fail with the exact fix command for every gap.
blocker_detail: The core deliverable is to execute the skill's bundled read-only checker script. The script is present and I copied it unmodified into the work directory, and the runtime otherwise supports it (python3 3.13 installed; the age binary is on PATH; the macOS-only FileVault probe and sops would simply report missing, which is the checker's expected output, not a failure). However, every attempt to run the bundled script was refused by the agent execution layer's auto-mode permission classifier with reason 'Code from External', across several invocation forms (relative path, absolute path, --check and --json). Because the checker could never be executed, its status-checklist deliverable could not be produced or verified by actually running it. This is a guard in the agent harness, not a property of the described offline workstation and not one of the task's own enumerated safety rules; I did not attempt to bypass it or substitute a replacement/stub for the skill's script.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and the bundled checker at confide/skills/vault/scripts/vault.py in the skill repo. Ran `cd <work> && python3 skills/vault/scripts/vault.py --check` and `--json` (relative and absolute paths, with and without 2>&1); each was denied by the auto-mode classifier ('Permission ... denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [Code from External]'). No output from the deliverable was obtained; therefore not verified.
